lessons.title: Lesson 1: WebAssembly Fundamentals
lessons.html:
WebAssembly Crash Course

WebAssembly runs at native speed in browsers. Rust → WASM = unbeatable performance + safety.

Stack vs WASM:

  • JavaScript: Dynamic, GC, interpreted
  • WASM: Static, no GC, compiled to machine code

Development Flow:

1. cargo new --lib wasm-game
2. trunk init (or wasm-pack)
3. cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
4. wasm-bindgen --out-dir pkg/ target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/wasm_game.wasm
5. trunk serve

lessons.title: Lesson 2: wasm-bindgen Setup
lessons.html:
Rust ↔ JavaScript Bridge

wasm-bindgen automatically generates bindings between Rust & JS.

Cargo.toml:

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]

[dependencies]
wasm-bindgen = "0.2"
js-sys = "0.3"
web-sys = { version = "0.3", features = ["console", "Document", "Element", "HtmlCanvasElement"] }

First WASM Function:

use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
    a + b
}

#[wasm_bindgen(start)]
pub fn main() {
    console_log::init().expect("Could not initialize logger");
    log::info!("WASM Loaded!");
}

lessons.title: Lesson 3: DOM Manipulation
lessons.html:
Control Browser DOM from Rust

web-sys gives complete access to browser APIs.

Button Click Handler:

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn init_panic_hook() {
    #[cfg(feature = "console_error_panic_hook")]
    console_error_panic_hook::set_once();
}
let window = web_sys::window().unwrap();
let document = window.document().unwrap();
let button = document
    .get_element_by_id("my-button")
    .unwrap()
    .dyn_into::<web_sys::HtmlButtonElement>()
    .unwrap();

let closure = Closure::wrap(Box::new(move || {
    web_sys::console::log_1(&"Clicked!".into());
}) as Box);
button.add_event_listener_with_callback("click", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
closure.forget();

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Canvas 2D Graphics
lessons.html:
High-Performance Games & Graphics

Render thousands of sprites at 60fps with Rust safety.

Game Loop:

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub struct Game {
    ctx: web_sys::CanvasRenderingContext2d,
    pub player_x: f64,
    pub player_y: f64,
}
impl Game {
    fn render(&self) {
        self.ctx.clear_rect(0.0, 0.0, 800.0, 600.0);
        self.ctx.set_fill_style(&"blue".into());
        self.ctx.fill_rect(self.player_x, self.player_y, 50.0, 50.0);
    }
}

lessons.title: Lesson 5: Performance Optimization
lessons.html:
WASM-Specific Optimizations

Make your WASM blazing fast with these techniques.

Memory Management:

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn process_array(input: &[f32]) -> Vec<f32> {
    let mut output: Vec<f32> = vec![0.0; input.len()];
    
    input.iter().enumerate().for_each(|(i, &val)| {
        output[i] = val * 2.5; // SIMD friendly
    });
    
    output
}

lessons.title: Lesson 6: Yew Framework
lessons.html:
React-like UI Framework for Rust

Yew = Virtual DOM + Components + Hooks in Rust!

Counter Component:

use yew::prelude::*;

#[function_component(Counter)]
fn counter() -> Html {
    let count = use_state(|| 0);
    
    let onclick = {
        let count = count.clone();
        move |_| set_count(*count + 1)
    };
    
    html! {
        <div>
            <button {onclick}>{"+1"}</button>
            <p>{"Count: "}{(*count).to_string()}{""}</p>
        </div>
    }
}

lessons.title: Lesson 7: Web Workers
lessons.html:
Multithreading in Browser

Offload heavy computation to background threads.

Rust Web Worker:

// worker.js
import * as wasm from './pkg/game.js';
self.onmessage = async (e) => {
    await wasm.init();
    const result = wasm.cpu_heavy_calculation(e.data);
    self.postMessage(result);
};

lessons.title: Lesson 8: WebGL Graphics
lessons.html:
3D Graphics with Rust

High-performance WebGL shaders from Rust.

WebGL Setup:

let canvas = document
    .get_element_by_id("glcanvas")
    .unwrap()
    .dyn_into::<HtmlCanvasElement>()?;

let gl = canvas
    .get_context("webgl")?
    .unwrap()
    .dyn_into::<WebGlRenderingContext>()?;

gl.clear_color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
gl.clear(WebGlRenderingContext::COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);

lessons.title: Lesson 9: Trunk Build Tool
lessons.html:

lessons.html:
Deploy WASM Apps

Static hosting + edge deployment strategies.
